Method of Attack: Uses multiple layers of obfuscation to hide malicious code
Checks if the system is Linux and creates a file in /tmp/file.py with commands to download and execute a script from GitHub
Attempts to create directories and files, downloads scripts from remote URLs, and executes them
Impacted Systems: Systems where the malicious packages are installed via PyPI
Attack Vector: Typosquatting to mimic popular package names
Published on PyPI, which is a trusted repository for Python developers
Indicators of Compromise: Obfuscated Python code in the packages
Creation of /tmp/file.py and execution of commands within it
